parts.text: Comparing **Otter.ai vs Fireflies.ai vs Fathom** for sales calls: Otter.ai leads in transcription accuracy and real-time collaboration features. Fireflies.ai wins on CRM automation with 50+ integrations. Fathom is best for free usage with unlimited recordings. For sales teams, Fireflies.ai's auto-logging to Salesforce and deal insights justify the cost. Otter.ai's speaker identification and searchable transcripts help with coaching.
